text:
Devon: Heads-up — noticed a discrepancy between the console 'per-route token' panel and the backend ledger after a router swap. Small repro attached.
Maria: Can you paste the session id + quick query?
Devon: session: sess_7fa12ab9. Query I ran: `SELECT * FROM token_ledger WHERE session_id='sess_7fa12ab9' ORDER BY ts;` Returned two provisional credits and one confirmed charge. Console shows only the confirmed one.
Aj: Hmm. Sounds like the provisional->confirm transition isn't getting emitted in the event stream the frontend subscribes to. Which emitter owns route_tag? Could be lost during handoff.
Devon: Repro steps: 1) start streaming toolcall 2) trigger a canary router-swap (simulate by killing pod) 3) client reconnects and resumes. Logs show: `router=R1 handoff=session:sess_7fa12ab9 provisional_credit=125` then later `router=R2 confirm=125` but frontend never rendered provisional row.
Lina: Frontend expects an event type `ledger.provisional` before `ledger.confirm`. Backend currently emits `provisional.v2` (dot) as the new name. So name mismatch.
Maria: ah — telemetry naming drift. Backend emits event.name = `ledger.provisional.v2` while frontend looks for `ledger.provisional_v2` (underscore). :facepalm:
Samir: Okay, small naming bug but impact is visibility. Patch seems trivial but need rollout plan. Dedicated/private customers might have pinned agents.
Aj: UX + rollout notes: If we ship backend fix (emit compatibility name), dashboard should gracefully show a fallback for confirmed-only cases: synthesize a provisional row (dashed) with a tooltip "reconstructed from ledger" so operators aren't confused.
Maria: Agreed. Also add a console metric `console.provisional_mismatch` so we can alert on spikes.
Devon: For SRE debugging, here's a logs query snippet they can run: `curl -G "https://logs.redwood/api/v1/search" --data-urlencode "q=route:R2 AND session:sess_7fa12ab9 AND message:provisional"`
ops-bot: Deploy queued: backend/ledger-emitter v1.3.5 -> canary (tag: canary-2025-03-10)
Samir: Also propose a reconciliation job: scan confirmed rows with no provisional, emit a synthetic provisional event (marked synthetic) so historical views populate. Mark those events in telemetry as `synthetic=true`. Needs SRE signoff.
Lina: I'll send a PR to frontend to accept both `ledger.provisional.v2` and `ledger.provisional_v2`, and render synthetic provisional rows when only confirm exists.
Maria: I'll own the console changes: CONSOLE-928 (metric + tooltip copy + dashed row styling).
Samir: I'll own BACKEND-1422 (emit both names + reconciliation job) and SRE-513 for the backfill runbook.
Devon: Timeline: canary is up now; rollback window 2h. If no regressions, we'll sweep to prod. Please add unit tests for event name compatibility and an e2e that simulates router-swap reconnection.
Aj: Added as a requirement on BACKEND-1422.
Devon: Thanks all. Also note: let's add a short blurb in the rollout notes explaining "why users might see a missing provisional row briefly" so support can triage faster. :thumbsup:
